data.title: A new information panel at the Zámčisko hillfort above Modra
data.excerpt: On 20 October 2013 our Hradiská civic association unveiled a new information panel at the Zámčisko hillfort above Modra, made in cooperation with the town of Modra and the Bratislava Region. The text was consulted with Dr Zdenko Farkaš, who had excavated the site, and the panel was christened with genuine old Slavic mead from a drinking horn.

children.text: On 20 October 2013 we gathered at the

hillfort above Modra to unveil our new information panel together. Our pagan priest had evidently performed demanding sacrificial rites the day before, because the gods granted us incredibly fine autumn weather.

This time we created our new information panel in cooperation with the town of Modra, which, together with the Bratislava Self-Governing Region, not only funded the panel but also arranged for the manufacture and installation of its massive wooden frame, thanks to which we were able to concentrate solely on creating the information board itself.

We consulted the text of the panel with Dr Zdenko Farkaš, who had carried out excavations at the hillfort in the past. He also provided us with images of the finds in good resolution for the panel. The picture of the hillfort – a detail of the fortifications – was drawn for us by the academic painter Tomáš Polonský. Everything else was created by the members of our Hradiská civic association. We unveiled the panel and “christened” it with genuine old Slavic mead from a Slavic drinking horn.

children.text: We believe that the panel will help to better inform the tourists who come to this magical place, and that it will not fall victim to vandalism. We thank the town of Modra, above all the mayor and the staff of the town hall, for their obliging attitude and their help with this project.
